# XBoost (`iscvlab/xboost` `v3.6.0`)

> Production 15-skill `/x*` AI agent engineering framework, Sharded `L1+L2` 4-Tier Compound Learning Playbooks, and 10 deterministic Python CLI & MCP sidecar engines (`22,237` LOC) for **any AI coding agent — cloud, IDE, CLI, or local LLM (`Ollama`, `vLLM`, `LM Studio`, `OpenHands`, `Cline`, `Continue`, `Aider`, `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Grok`, `Gemini / Antigravity`, or custom agent frameworks)** on **Windows, macOS, and Linux**. Covers deep reasoning (`/xboost`), swarm orchestration (`/xultra`), primary-source research (`/xdeep-research`), elastic sharded compound learning & 5-Gate Universal Law ratcheting (`/xlearn`), 5-profile System 1 → System 1.5 semantic, AST/brace-code & conformal triage (`/xlaya` `v2.4.0` — `laya 0.4.31+`, `vegaml 0.16.1+`, Wallacei `v2.7` K-fold OOF `NSGA-II` MOO, `8.50–10.41 MB` zero-torch `--profile nano`, `6,237 B` LF `sieve_genomes.json`, `65.12%` `E4B R@3` / `79.07%` `31B R@8` blind `Kaggle 129 R1`, `78.72%` `SWE-bench_Verified` `R@8`, `71.69%` `When2Call` MCQ, `~30 ms` warm MCP, `859.1 q/s` GPU batch, `90.0%` `vega-U` routing accuracy, `100%` Joint NLI Triad, and `0.00%` XERJ `#1108` wrong-and-confident fires), Obsidian knowledge graphs (`/xobsidian`), hybrid CAD/table/Thai OCR (`/xocr` `v2.4.0`), non-intrusive Ghost Mouse & Multi-Agent Visual Cursor HUD (`/xmouse`), doc sync (`/xsync`), and unified pre-flight release audits, upstream PR convergence & QGIS 4 packaging (`/xpublish`). Verified across `24` upstream open-source PRs + `1` Hold (`10 MERGED`).

## One-Prompt Universal Agent Install

```text
Install iscvlab/xboost (https://github.com/iscvlab/xboost): detect my OS and your active global or workspace skills directory, clone the repository, install all 15 /x* skills (Windows: ./scripts/install.ps1 -All; macOS/Linux: ./scripts/install.sh --all; or copy skills/* directly into your active skills folder), run python skills/xpublish/scripts/audit_engine.py skills/xboost --platform skill to verify the CLI harness, and confirm all 15 /x* commands are ready.
```

## Core Entrypoints & Universal Install

- [README.md](README.md): Architecture, benchmarks, one-prompt agent installer, and universal agent verification matrix.
- [docs/COMPOUND_LEARNING_PLAYBOOK.md](docs/COMPOUND_LEARNING_PLAYBOOK.md): `L1` Cross-Workspace Compound Learning Router Hub (`~13.7 KB` LF) indexing `24 PAT-*/OPT-*` across `21` prefix families, `13 FALS-01..13`, `7 GOV-01..07`, `24 PRs + 1 Hold`, and `8` Tier 2/3 Domain Playbooks.
- [docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1A_ALGORITHMS_VECTOR_GPU_CONCURRENCY.md](docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1A_ALGORITHMS_VECTOR_GPU_CONCURRENCY.md): `L2` Tier 1A Shard (`13` patterns across `10` families, including `OPT-MOO-01` multi-objective OOF evolution, Duchi `float64` simplex & anchor parity).
- [docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1B_SPATIAL_VISION_OCR_AGENTS.md](docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1B_SPATIAL_VISION_OCR_AGENTS.md): `L2` Tier 1B Shard (`5` spatial/GIS, vision, CAD/Thai OCR, botanical `NULL` & SWE agent/container patterns).
- [docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1C_CAD_MCP_WEB_IOT_QUANT.md](docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1C_CAD_MCP_WEB_IOT_QUANT.md): `L2` Tier 1C Shard (`6` desktop CAD/GIS, 4D Clifford PBR, MCP/COM IPC, DOM/SQLite, BLE IoT & Walk-Forward Quant patterns).
- [docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1D_FALSIFICATION_GOVERNANCE_OSS_ROLLUP.md](docs/playbooks/PLAYBOOK_1D_FALSIFICATION_GOVERNANCE_OSS_ROLLUP.md): `L2` Tier 1D Shard (`FALS-01..13`, `GOV-01..07`, and Master `24` PR + `1` Hold OSS Rollup).
- [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell installer (`./scripts/install.ps1 -All` or `-Target <dir>`).
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh): macOS and Linux installer (`./scripts/install.sh --all` or `--target <dir>`).

## Skills & Bundled CLI Engines

- [skills/xboost/SKILL.md](skills/xboost/SKILL.md): XBoost deep reasoning, Ponytail x Deep Module design ladder, and Red-Green verification loop.
- [skills/xultra/SKILL.md](skills/xultra/SKILL.md): Elastic Cognitive Swarm (`K`-vector tournament, evolutionary ratchet, and blind Maker-vs-Checker verification).
- [skills/xdeep-research/SKILL.md](skills/xdeep-research/SKILL.md): 5-wave primary-source research and blind adversarial audit.
- [skills/xdeep-research/scripts/verify_evidence.py](skills/xdeep-research/scripts/verify_evidence.py): Automated URL, citation, and evidence gate verifier (`286` LOC).
- [skills/xlearn/SKILL.md](skills/xlearn/SKILL.md): Compound learning ratchet, elastic `L1+L2` Playbook shard updater with cross-shard `/xlaya` dedup, and 5-Gate Universal Law evolution engine (`/xlearn`, `/learn`).
- [skills/xlaya/SKILL.md](skills/xlaya/SKILL.md): 5-profile System 1 → System 1.5 (`choice`, `score`, `noul`, `sieve_code_graph`, `triage_tool_call`, `vega-U` conformal) semantic decision and conflict triage sidecar (`v2.4.0`).
- [skills/xlaya/resources/sieve_genomes.json](skills/xlaya/resources/sieve_genomes.json): Wallacei `v2.7` K-fold OOF `NSGA-II` CUDA-evolved 8D code-graph simplex & Platt policy (`6,237 B` LF JSON).
- [skills/xlaya/scripts/laya_triage.py](skills/xlaya/scripts/laya_triage.py): AST + `--pattern web` brace-code & 6-level breadcrumb chunker, 8D simplex sieve, 2-stage conformal `tool_gate`, 3-Question Joint NLI Triad, `predict_tournament` (`>20` labels), and `laya 0.4.31+` / `vegaml 0.16.1+` CLI runner (`7,943` LOC).
- [skills/xlaya/scripts/xlaya_mcp_server.py](skills/xlaya/scripts/xlaya_mcp_server.py): Zero-extra-dependency JSON-RPC 2.0 `stdio` MCP 6-tool server (`xlaya_triage`, `xlaya_predict`, `xlaya_fit`, `xlaya_status`, `xlaya_preload`, `xlaya_unload`) with AST-checked hot-reload, `~30 ms` warm inference, and idle VRAM auto-unload (`1,035` LOC).
- [skills/xobsidian/SKILL.md](skills/xobsidian/SKILL.md): 2-Hop Hub + Cross-Domain Bridge knowledge graph maintenance and 1-line Graph Integrity Verification Gate.
- [skills/xocr/SKILL.md](skills/xocr/SKILL.md): Hybrid PyMuPDF vector/table extractor, grid-bubble & callout diff engine, Thai PUA normalizer, and 5-profile OCR engine (`v2.4.0`).
- [skills/xocr/scripts/ocr_runner.py](skills/xocr/scripts/ocr_runner.py): CLI engine for PDF/CAD/image text, revision diff, and RFC-4180 CSV table extraction (`7,455` LOC).
- [skills/xmouse/SKILL.md](skills/xmouse/SKILL.md): Non-intrusive Multi-Agent Ghost Mouse, Hybrid UIA + Set-of-Mark desktop controller, and Visual Multi-Cursor HUD (`/xmouse`).
- [skills/xmouse/scripts/xmouse_cli.py](skills/xmouse/scripts/xmouse_cli.py): Zero-dependency CLI & FastMCP server for background Win32 PostMessage, UIA inspection, Set-of-Mark vision capture, and HUD telemetry (`1,891` LOC).
- [skills/xplan/SKILL.md](skills/xplan/SKILL.md): Architectural implementation planner with inline grilling and verification matrices.
- [skills/xbrief/SKILL.md](skills/xbrief/SKILL.md): Same-turn workspace architecture loader with selective `L1 → L2` playbook shard routing.
- [skills/xsync/SKILL.md](skills/xsync/SKILL.md): Post-change documentation synchronization and stale-reference purger.
- [skills/xsync/scripts/audit_workspace_docs.py](skills/xsync/scripts/audit_workspace_docs.py): Automated metric, version, cross-repo `--federated` `L1+L2` playbook/skill mirror, symlink-safe host root discovery, and dead-link scanner (`581` LOC).
- [skills/xpublish/SKILL.md](skills/xpublish/SKILL.md): Unified pre-flight secret/AST/YAML auditor, upstream PR review-bot convergence gate, and QGIS 4 release packager (`/xpublish`, `/xpublish-audit`, `/xpublish-qgis`, `/publish`).
- [skills/xpublish/references/github_readme_protocol.md](skills/xpublish/references/github_readme_protocol.md): GitHub Repository Publishing & Visual README Protocol `v1.5` (including `§6.D` Upstream PR Etiquette & Review-Bot Convergence).
- [skills/xpublish/references/qgis_release_protocol.md](skills/xpublish/references/qgis_release_protocol.md): 5-Gate Deterministic QGIS 4 / Qt6 Release Packaging Protocol.
- [skills/xpublish/scripts/audit_engine.py](skills/xpublish/scripts/audit_engine.py): Zero-dependency AST/YAML/regex security, skill budget, and diff-scoped PR linter (`--platform pr|github|qgis|food4rhino|skill|generic`, `1,368` LOC).
- [skills/xpublish/scripts/package_qgis.py](skills/xpublish/scripts/package_qgis.py): Single-root ZIP builder and `metadata.txt` validator (`587` LOC).
- [skills/xpublish/scripts/check_qt6.py](skills/xpublish/scripts/check_qt6.py): Qt6/QGIS 4 scoped-enum AST compatibility verifier (`422` LOC).
- [skills/xcreate-skill/SKILL.md](skills/xcreate-skill/SKILL.md): Global skill builder, distiller, and evolutionary auditor.
- [skills/xcontext/SKILL.md](skills/xcontext/SKILL.md): Session context window, compaction, and SQLite token telemetry inspector.
- [skills/xcontext/scripts/check_context.py](skills/xcontext/scripts/check_context.py): Transcript and `.vscdb` token usage analyzer (`669` LOC).
- [skills/xkickoff/SKILL.md](skills/xkickoff/SKILL.md): End-of-session progress synthesizer and fresh-session handoff generator.
